about.question: wants information
about.remember: explicitly asks the assistant to remember something
about.statement: tells the assistant something about their life without asking for anything
about.small_talk: needs nothing back: ok, thanks, lol
about.none: no tool: the reply can be written directly
about.web_search: current or local facts from the internet
about.web_browser: reading a specific link in the message
about.file_read: reading the person's saved lists, notes or files
about.file_write: saving, adding to or changing a list, note or file
about.memory_recall: something the person told the assistant before
about.ask_first: true only when something needed is missing and has to be asked
